app.title: TR Dizin Pre-Assessment Tool
app.subtitle: Self-test your journal against the TR Dizin prerequisites and evaluation criteria before you apply.
app.disclaimer: This tool is an independent project and is not affiliated with TÜBİTAK ULAKBİM or TR Dizin. A positive outcome in the pre-assessment does not guarantee acceptance into TR Dizin. After the monitoring period, the TR Dizin committee makes the final decision according to the criteria at https://trdizin.gov.tr/kriterler/.
legend.title: About criterion numbers
legend.text: The numbers in parentheses are the item numbers on TR Dizin's official criteria page: Prerequisite = prerequisites for a journal application, Criterion = journal evaluation criteria, General Point = general points to take into consideration, Recommendation = recommendations.

step.identity.title: 1. Journal Identity
step.identity.journalTitleHint: Must match the name in the ISSN record (Prerequisite 5).
step.identity.homepageUrlHint: The journal needs its own independent website; the ISSN must appear on the homepage and the site must state that the journal is peer-reviewed and scholarly (Prerequisite 6, Prerequisite 7, Prerequisite 8).
step.identity.issnHint: At least one is required; the ISSN must have been issued by the ISSN Office of the Ministry of Culture and Tourism (Prerequisite 3, Prerequisite 4).
step.identity.subjectAreaHint: Determines the minimum number of issues per year: Health Sciences at least 3, Engineering/Basic Sciences/Veterinary at least 2, Social Sciences and Humanities at least 1 (Prerequisite 2). Review-only and case-report-only journals follow separate rules.
step.identity.issuesPerYearHint: The number of issues the journal announces per year (Prerequisite 2).
step.identity.publishedIssueCountHint: At least one issue must have been published before applying to TR Dizin (Prerequisite 1).
step.identity.publicationLanguagesHint: Languages in which articles are published; the publication language must be stated in the journal (Prerequisite 8). Press Enter after each language.
step.website.title: 2. Website & Policies
step.website.aimsAndScopeUrlHint: The journal's aims and scope must be described in detail (Prerequisite 9).
step.website.authorGuidelinesUrlHint: Must describe tables, figures, headings, abstract and reference formatting in detail and name the citation style used, e.g. APA or MLA (Criterion 11, General Point 9).
step.website.publicationPolicyUrlHint: Open-access information, the fee policy (if any), and the review duration and process must appear under a "publication policy" heading (Criterion 12).
step.website.journalInfoComplete: Journal information is complete on the inner cover and/or website.
step.website.journalInfoCompleteHint: Full name, other-language name and abbreviation (if any), ISSN, postal address, language, frequency and months, institutional e-mail, publisher, printer, editor and boards (Prerequisite 8).
step.website.nameChanged: The journal name has changed before.
step.website.nameChangedHint: When the name changes, a new ISSN must be obtained and the old name must be shown for at least two years (General Point 2).
step.website.hasJournalHistory: Name and ISSN changes are listed with year ranges under "Journal History" in the "About" section.
step.website.indexingClaimsAccurate: The journal and website contain no misleading statements about "indexed in" sources.
step.website.indexingClaimsAccurateHint: False or unverifiable indexing and impact factor claims count against the application (General Point 13).
step.website.abbreviationShown: The journal abbreviation is shown in the journal.
step.editorialBoards.title: 3. Editors & Boards
step.editorialBoards.editorialBoardUrlHi: Each board member must be listed with their institution, or at least city and country (Criterion 4).
step.editorialBoards.boardOneThirdExtern: At least one third of the editorial board comes from different institutions.
Editorial and advisory boards need institutional diversity (Criterion 4).
step.editorialBoards.hasFieldEditorsHint: Institution-based and broad-scope journals should have field editors (Criterion 2).
step.editorialBoards.hasLanguageEditors: The journal has language editors for its publication language(s).
step.editorialBoards.hasLanguageEditorsH: Compliance with the spelling and grammar rules of the language must be ensured (Criterion 3).
step.editorialBoards.hasAdvisoryBoard: The journal has an advisory board.
step.editorialBoards.hasAdvisoryBoardHin: The advisory board should also be institutionally diverse (Criterion 4).
step.editorialBoards.boardCompetenceStat: The competence of editors and board members (publications, expertise) is traceable.
step.peerReview.title: 4. Peer Review & Plagiarism
step.peerReview.peerReviewPolicyUrlHint: Must describe the review process, the number of reviewers per article and the blinding method (Criterion 15).
step.peerReview.minTwoReviewers: At least two reviewers are assigned to every article.
step.peerReview.reviewersFromDifferentIn: Reviewers come from different institutions and match the article's field.
Impartiality and diversity principles must be observed (Criterion 6, Criterion 15).
step.peerReview.thirdReviewerOnDisagreem: If two reviewers disagree, the editor or a third reviewer is consulted.
step.peerReview.reportsKeptFiveYears: Review reports are kept for at least five years after publication.
step.peerReview.reportsShowScientificEva: Review reports contain a scientific evaluation, not only a formal check.
step.peerReview.canUploadReviewReportsPd: I can provide the entire review process of an article as a single PDF.
Original submission, first and second reviewer opinions, revisions (if any), reviewer names, institutions and review dates (Criterion 16).
step.peerReview.screensPlagiarismHint: Recommendation: use of plagiarism software should be announced in the journal and/or website (Recommendation 3).
step.peerReview.publishesReviewerList: The reviewer list is announced per issue, volume or year.
step.articleFormat.title: 5. Article Format
step.articleFormat.sampleArticleUrlHint: Link to a recent article page or PDF. Abstract, keywords, article type, dates, ORCID and references are checked on this article (Prerequisite 10–13, General Point 8, General Point 11).
step.articleFormat.abstractAndKeywordsIn: Articles include an abstract and keywords in the article language.
Abstract and keywords must follow international standards (Prerequisite 10).
step.articleFormat.abstractWordLimitStat: A word limit for abstracts is stated and followed.
step.articleFormat.publishesNonLatinScri: The journal publishes articles written in a non-Latin script.
For example Arabic, Cyrillic or Syriac (Prerequisite 11).
step.articleFormat.latinScriptForNonLati: These articles also provide a title, abstract, keywords and references in Latin script.
step.articleFormat.articleTypeOnTocAndFi: The article type (research, review, case report, etc.) is shown in the table of contents and on the first page.
step.articleFormat.datesSubmissionAccept: Submission and acceptance dates appear on the first page of each article.
Preferably at the bottom of the page (Prerequisite 13).
step.articleFormat.affiliationsAndOrcidS: All authors' affiliations, contact details and ORCID iDs appear on the first page.
step.articleFormat.noAdsInsideArticles: Advertisements do not appear inside articles and are not given page numbers.
step.articleFormat.referenceStyleHint: An international style must be used and described in detail in the author guidelines (General Point 9).
step.articleFormat.referencesLatinScript: Every scholarly article has a reference list written in Latin script.
Accuracy and accessibility of references must be ensured (General Point 8).
step.articleFormat.footnoteReferencesLis: In articles using footnotes, the sources are also listed in a reference list at the end.
step.articleFormat.citationLineOnFirstPa: A citation line with bibliographic information appears on the first page.
Preferably at the top; example: Akd. Araş Derg, 2014; 15(2): 15-22 (General Point 11).
step.articleFormat.issueCoverHasNameYear: Every issue (print and web) shows the journal name, year, volume and issue number.
step.articleFormat.pageNumberingContinuo: Page numbers start at 1 in the first issue and continue across issues of the same volume.
Journals published by issue number without volumes may restart at 1 in each issue (Criterion 14).
step.articleFormat.pdfTextCopyable: The text of issue PDF files can be copied (not scanned images).
step.articleFormat.pdfTextCopyableHint: Application requirement: the content of issue PDFs must be copyable.
step.articleFormat.bilingualTitleAbstrac: Titles, abstracts and keywords are also published in a language other than the publication language.
Recommendation (Recommendation 5). Turkish is not required for journals publishing in English only.
step.articleFormat.bilingualTocTitles: Article titles in the table of contents are given in Turkish and English.
step.ethics.title: 6. Ethics
step.ethics.ethicsPolicyUrlHint: Ethical principles must appear under a separate heading, with separate sections for authors, reviewers and editors, citing standards such as COPE/ICMJE (Criterion 8.3–8.5).
step.ethics.separateSectionsForRoles: The website gives ethics rules under separate headings for reviewers, authors and editors.
step.ethics.referencesCopeOrIcmje: The ethics principles cite national and international standards such as COPE and/or ICMJE.
step.ethics.statesResearchPublicationEth: The website states that articles comply with Research and Publication Ethics.
step.ethics.requiresEthicsCommitteeAppro: For studies requiring ethics approval, the approval details (committee, date, number) are given in the methods section and on the first or last page.
step.ethics.requiresInformedConsentForCa: Case reports state that a signed informed-consent form was obtained.
Mandatory for health and case-report journals, advisory for others (Criterion 8.2).
step.ethics.requiresDeclarationsAtArticl: Articles end with contribution-rate, support/acknowledgement and conflict-of-interest statements.
step.ethics.respectsCopyrightForWorksUse: Copyright regulations are respected for ideas and works of art used.
step.content.title: 7. Content & Regularity
step.content.publishesOnTime: Issues are published on schedule at the announced intervals and uploaded to ODİS.
step.content.publishesOnTimeHint: Journals that do not upload issues on time are not accepted into TR Dizin (Criterion 1).
step.content.researchArticlesLastYear: Research articles published in the last year
step.content.researchArticlesLastYearHin: At least 12 in health fields; in other fields research articles must make up at least 50% of all scholarly articles (Criterion 10).
step.content.totalScientificArticlesLast: Total scholarly articles published in the last year
Sum of research articles, case reports and reviews (Criterion 10).
step.content.articleCountsBalanced: The number of articles is balanced across issues and volumes.
step.content.authorInstitutionDiversity: Published articles show institutional and author diversity.
step.content.combinedIssuesLast3Years: Combined issues published in the last 3 years
step.content.combinedIssuesLast3YearsHin: A combined issue may be published only once per 3 years, for two consecutive issues (Criterion 17).
step.content.specialIssuesLastYear: Special/supplementary issues published in the last year
step.content.specialIssuesLastYearHint: Special/supplementary issues may not exceed one third of the regular period; congress abstract issues are excluded (Criterion 18.3).
step.content.specialIssuesSeparatePaging: Special/supplementary issues are paginated separately from regular issues.
step.content.onlyReviewOrCaseReportState: The journal states that it publishes only reviews / only case reports.
Additional requirement for review-only and case-report-only journals (item 1).
step.content.metadataSubmissionMethodHin: Journals on DergiPark submit via DergiPark; journals using only TR Dizin enter data manually or upload TR Dizin XML (Application Agreement items 13–14).
step.review.title: 8. Review
step.review.description: Review the information below, confirm the application agreement, then run the pre-assessment.
agreement.title: Journal Application Agreement
agreement.description: Items 1–14 of the agreement are computed automatically from your answers; item 15 requires your confirmation.
agreement.item1: I provide detailed information about the journal's aim.
agreement.item2: I describe the scope of the journal.
agreement.item3: I use and display author guidelines.
agreement.item5: I show an abstract in the publication language.
agreement.item8: I state the publication language in the journal.
agreement.item9: In printed copies I place advertisements without page numbers and in line with ethical rules.
agreement.item10: When publishing more than one article type, I indicate the article classification on the title page and in the table of contents.
agreement.item12: I use a standard citation format in all articles.
agreement.item13: For DergiPark users: I will submit my article data from that source.
agreement.item14: For journals using only TR Dizin: I will submit my article data manually in the system or using the TR Dizin XML standard.
agreement.item15: I have read, understood and accept the information at https://trdizin.gov.tr/kriterler/ and will comply.
agreement.criteriaLink: Open the TR Dizin criteria page
agreement.required: You must confirm item 15 to run the assessment.
